name: tia_get_compile_state
description: List the compile state of PLC blocks and PLC data types without compiling (read-only): IsConsistent, IsKnowHowProtected, CompileDate, ModifiedDate, CodeModifiedDate and InterfaceModifiedDate per block, IsConsistent per type, and totals. IsConsistent is null when TIA does not report it. Openness cannot read the warnings TIA stored from an earlier compile.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact block-group path to list (with its subgroups); omit or use an empty string for all blocks. Types are always listed from the root.

only_inconsistent.description: List only blocks and types that are not consistent or whose state is unknown (default false). Totals always count everything.

include_types.description: Also list PLC data types (default true).
